newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine minister promises on-time T-bill payments.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine minister promises on-time T-bill payments.

text.p: Ukraine's new Finance Minister promised on Friday that his ministry would always meet deadlines for Treasury bill payments.

"We clearly state that meeting our obligations is the first necessity for growth and development of the T-bill market," Ihor Mityukov told a commercial bankers' meeting in his first public statement since his appointment last month.
Last September the deputy prime minister in charge of the economy, Viktor Pynzenyk, issued a public apology after the Finance Ministry delayed Treasury bill payments three times in a month.
Mityukov said T-bills would be main source of covering the deficit in the 1997 budget, still awaiting passage by Ukraine's parliament together with a tax reform package.

In most recent auctions, usually held twice weekly, three-month discount paper fetched yields of 20 percent, six-month paper yields were at 30 percent, and nine- and 12-month paper were between 30 and 35 percent.
